claim_ceiling: Synthetic authenticated-history-ingest conformance corpus. No production cryptographic verifier, source adapter, event store, broker, database, or ingest performance result has been executed or qualified.
core_rule: Only exact, authenticated, complete source coverage may produce READY. Missing, unavailable, truncated or uncovered evidence must never be converted into a passing HistoryEvidence.

scenarios.description: All source manifests authenticate, exact event IDs are covered once, owner streams cover the inventory, inventory closure verifies and global owner-ack-set verifier confirms the canonical receipts.
A required effect owner has no authenticated source-stream manifest in the capture interval.
Source-manifest signature or verifier policy is invalid.
The source signature verifier or required trust key is unavailable.
An authenticated source manifest declares an event ID that is missing from the supplied bundle.
The same event ID is claimed by overlapping source stream manifests.
An event scope digest differs from the exact bundle or signed source-manifest scope.
An event owner identity differs from the owner identity asserted by its source stream manifest.
The independently verified inventory-closure proof is invalid.
The inventory-closure verifier is unavailable or its trust root cannot be reached.
The owner-ack-set verifier recomputes a different canonical owner-ack set or its signature commitment is invalid.
The owner-ack-set verifier is unavailable, so the global barrier receipt cannot be authenticated.
A global barrier receipt references an owner acknowledgement absent from the event bundle.
A supplied event is not covered by any authenticated source manifest.
Two source manifests reuse the same source and stream identity.
The route-to-owner projection in an authenticated inventory does not equal the declared exact owner set.
An authenticated source manifest claims an owner outside the exact owner set in the verified inventory.
The declared source event count differs from the exact event-ID set size.

comparator_methods: Mycelix authenticated manifest-to-event exact coverage and owner-stream closure
Porcupine executable sequential model and concurrent history linearizability checker after history is READY
Jepsen-style source capture, fault injection and independent consistency checking
evidence_requirements: exact ingest source SHA and binary digest
raw event bundle and exact source manifests
source verifier identity, policy digest and authenticated trust-root evidence
inventory closure proof and route-to-owner mapping commitment
owner-ack-set canonical bytes and digest verification transcript
per-run raw ingest timing and peak-memory samples
event IDs, owner stream cursors and completeness receipts
reproducible seeds, failure traces and exact schema version
all INCONCLUSIVE and failed bundles retained in benchmark denominator
